content: You are a concise assistant. Answer in plain text.
What is the capital of France?
The capital of France is Paris.
Write a Python one-liner that sums 1..100, and explain it in one sentence.
`print(sum(range(1, 101)))` adds every integer from 1 to 100 and prints 5050.
Translate "good morning" into Japanese and German.

Japanese: おはようございます (ohayō gozaimasu)
German: Guten Morgen
